title: Release comparison
summary: Two models answer the same batch of prompts before a release. Workers can retry, correct, or withdraw a label. Complete the component that turns their updates into a rollout decision.

title: Per-layer KV cache
summary: A decoder handles prompt prefill and incremental generation in separate calls. Complete the cache path for a supplied two-dimensional attention model.

title: Live continuous batching
summary: Your serving worker receives requests at different times. Wire the supplied model to a scheduler that admits new work while longer generations are still running.

title: Paged KV-cache allocator
summary: Requests grow one token at a time in a fixed physical memory pool. Implement reservation, logical addressing, and reuse when requests finish out of order.

title: Shared-prefix caching
summary: Several requests start with the same system prompt. Reuse compatible KV states while keeping each continuation and saved prefix independent.

title: Speculative decoding
summary: A small draft model proposes tokens in blocks. Complete the target verifier using supplied next-token distributions and deterministic random draws.

title: Blockwise attention
summary: An inference worker streams key/value blocks that cannot fit in a single score matrix. Compute one attention output while keeping the softmax stable as new maxima arrive.

title: Quantized linear inference
summary: A model exporter and a CPU inference worker must agree on a compact weight format. Calibrate output channels independently, run the layer, and serialize exactly what it stores.

title: Chat supervised fine-tuning
summary: A fine-tuning job is learning to echo user prompts. Build the data path from tokenized chat turns to a labeled training batch, and inspect exactly which tokens receive loss.

title: LoRA linear layer
summary: Extend a frozen projection with a trainable adapter, update it on one labeled example, and export a merged projection for serving.

title: DPO preference loss
summary: Train on preferred and rejected completions using scores from a policy and a frozen reference. Implement the masked objective and check its update signal at extreme margins.

title: Distributed data-parallel SGD
summary: A training job splits batches unevenly between workers. Implement rank-local gradients, their reduction, and synchronized updates. The browser simulates ranks; a two-process driver is included for local runs.

title: Paired statistical comparison
summary: Two releases answered the same questions. Estimate the improvement and its uncertainty when multiple questions share one source document.

title: LLM-judge validation
summary: A pairwise judge evaluates the same answers in both display orders. Audit it against held-out human labels and locate order sensitivity across tasks and answer lengths.

title: Durable tool execution and replay
summary: A mock-interview evaluator can crash after the remote tool finishes but before the turn is saved. Restore interrupted turns, preserve the first answer, and make retries safe across sessions.
